atoms.text: Fennec foxes are mammals that live in North Africa and the Middle East. They live in very hot and sandy places. They are cream-coloured so that they can blend into the sand. Fennec foxes have very large ears to help them hunt their prey at night. They usually sleep in tunnels under the sand during the day to avoid the hot sun. Fennec foxes are omnivores; meaning they eat meat and plants. Their diet is mostly insects, roots, fruit, eggs and lizards.
